'''Cave goblins''' are [[goblins]] of the ancient [[Dorgeshuun]] tribe found in the [[Lumbridge Swamp Caves]]. They are friendly creatures, and are willing to give many adventurers a [[tinderbox]] or a [[lit torch]] (if the player does not have one) when spoken to. When one of them is attacked, nearby cave goblins will scream certain phrases such as "Nooo!" or "Eeek!" while backing away.

==Update history==
{{UH|
* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Part 2 - Combat Style Modernisation|date=2 March 2026}}
** Default base hit chances increased:
*** Magic ('weak'): 65 → 70
*** Melee ('same'): 55 → 60
*** Ranged ('strong'): 45 → 50

* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Early-Game Rebalance|date=16 February 2026}}
** A number of early-game mobs will once again drop actual armour, weapons, ores, and bars.
*** Tiny plated bronze salvage → Bronze med helm, Bronze gauntlets
*** Tiny spiky bronze salvage → Bronze spear
*** Small plated bronze salvage → Bronze square shield
*** Medium plated bronze salvage → Bronze kiteshield

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Winter Patch Week - This Week In RuneScape|date=15 December 2025}}
** All 'Talk-to' options across the game have been replaced with 'Talk to'.

* {{UL|type=update|update=Lumbridge Swamp Caves|date=14 March 2005}}
** Added to game.
}}
